summary: Glenn County enclosed tower in the Mendocino National Forest, now listed as gone; a hiker's trip report found only a concrete foundation left at the site.

facts.status_note: Index marks it gone; a hiker's trip report says only a concrete foundation remains where the lookout stood

access.note: One undated hiker's trip report describes a gravel road to a trailhead and a trail; no closure is described in the sources read

visit.trail_note: A gravel road leads out to a trailhead for a trail leading about 2,000 ft down to Shepherd Creek, per one trip report

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Forest Lookouts page carries only a header (county and forest); two web searches found no build, staffing or removal history. The index gives coordinates 39.68863, -122.70863. The trip report is undated and is the only source on the site today. Access level public is an inference from the road and trail described there; verify with the Mendocino National Forest before publishing.
